display.title: Episode 361: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 6
display.summary_short: The poritz finds little Yehudah in the pit and raises him as his own son, Peter. Plus the Jewish Children's Expo, a young Shema guest, and the Shpoler Zeide's family day.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with news of Tzivos Hashem's Jewish Children's Expo at the Javits Center in early Adar. After the Hakochainik march, a boy of almost five from the Lubavitcher Yeshiva leads the Shema and tells what he learns in class. Story time continues The Return of Yehudah: the poritz finds the pit empty except for a blanket, and inside it little Yehudah. Childless, he takes the baby home and raises him as his own son, Peter, with no Shabbos, no kosher food and no Yiddishkeit. Reb Moshe and Sarah, now teaching in their new village, pray for their son. Twelve years pass; Peter grows into a brilliant, kind-hearted boy, until something mysterious reveals to him who he really is. Uncle Yossi then explains Yud-Tes Shevat, a special day for the descendants of the Shpoler Zeide, and announces their family gathering that night. The show closes with the Shiviti sign contest and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: No Jewish soul is ever lost forever; through Hashem's hashgachah pratis it will find its way back home.
